miko (PM): Quick callout  need to pick DP track today: "lighthouse" (2 full private partners, VPC+SSO+UI) or "broad" (8 light partners, docs+2 office hours). Which minimizes risk but preserves signal?

tess (Eng): Broad reduces delivery risk. Lighthouse gives deeper infra validation but is 4-6w of eng work for full hooks.

raf (Solutions): Sales has 2 lighthouse requests; rest want fast access. We could run broad and offer 2 lighthouse seats by invite-only.

anya (ProdResearch): Signal tradeoff: broad = more prompt variety; lighthouse = deeper integration metrics. I prefer broad for early quality sweeps.

zoe (Legal): If lighthouse accepted, I'll need to push a 1-page pilot addendum for private deploys. Can do in 48h.

ops-bot: Reminder: DP feature-branch deploy scheduled 2024-12-10T02:00Z (1749994200). Toggle migrations if needed.

miko (PM): Proposal: run broad by default, reserve 2 lighthouse seats for strategic partners who sign addendum and accept ETA risk. Acceptance gates for broad: 1) partner signs standard pilot terms; 2) telemetry enabled (req_id + sample); 3) smoke run within 72h; 4) <=2 major regressions.

tess (Eng): OK. add fallback: if a lighthouse partner converts to full mid-pilot, prioritize their work and pause new broad invites.

raf (Solutions): I'll draft invite language with two tracks and the fallback note. Also intake checkbox "apply for lighthouse seat".

anya (ProdResearch): I'll prepare T+2 and T+6 surveys and a simple dashboard: onboard_time, active_requests, regressions, partner_sat.

miko (PM): Action items: Raf -> invite + intake checkbox today. Tess -> confirm telemetry estimate + smoke script by tomorrow EOD. Anya -> survey + dashboard slice by Friday. Zoe -> addendum draft for lighthouse by Fri. Meeting Fri 09:00 to finalize. :white_check_mark:
